v: tri॰ anucarati anu + cara--Rvul । anugantari, sevake ca । tasya Darmyam aR । AnucArikam sevakaDarmye kAryye tri॰ ।
m: अनु-चारक m. a follower, attendant, (g. महिष्य्-आदि, q.v.)
a: अनुचारकः — A follower, servant &c. --रिका A female servant.

m: अनु-चारिका f. a female follower or attendant.
अनु-चारिन् mfn. following, attending.
अनु-च्छाद m. (√ छद्), a garment which hangs down (probably that part of the lower garment which hangs down in front from the waist to the feet), ŚBr.
a: अनुच्छादः — The part of a man's undergarment which is allowed to hang down in front from the waist to the feet (Mar. नित्या).

m: अन्-उच्-छेद m. = अन्-उच्-छित्ति.
अन्-उच्-छेद्य mfn. indestructible, not severable.
अनु-च्छिद् (√ छिद्) to cut along or lengthwise.
1. अन्-उच्-छिन्दत् mfn. not destroying.
2. अनु-च्छिन्दत् mfn. cutting lengthwise.
अन्-उच्-छिन्न mfn. not cut off
unextirpated.
अन्-उच्-छित्ति f. (√ छिद्), not cutting off, non-extirpation, non-destruction, indestructibility.
a: अनुच्छित्तिः — f., अनुच्छेदः Nonextirpation; non-destruction; indestructibility.

m: अन्-उच्-छित्ति—धर्मन् (अनुच्छित्ति-) mfn. possessing the virtue (or faculty) of being indestructible, ŚBr. xiv.

s: tri, (ut + Siz + kta, naYsamAsaH .) ucCizwaBinnaH । pavitraH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (“lakzmyA nimantrayAYcakre tamanucCizwasampadA” । iti raGuvaMSe .)
v: tri॰ ud + Siza--kta na॰ ta॰ । ucCizwaBinne AhAryyadravyasya BuktAvaSizwamucCizwaM tadBinne ।
m: अन्-उच्छिष्ट mfn. (√ शिष् with उद्), without remains or leavings of food, pure
not mere remains, Ragh.
a: अनुच्छिष्ट — a. Not rejected; pure, holy; fresh, unused; ˚यौवना Dk. 112.

m: अनु-च्छो (√ छो) cl. 4. P. (Imper. 2. sg. -छ्य) to cut open or cut up, AV. ix, 5, 4.
अनु-√ चक्ष् (perf. -चचक्ष; impf. Ā. -अचष्ट) to look at or up to, RV.

अनु-√ चर् to walk or move after or along; to follow, pursue, seek after; to follow out, adhere to, attend; to behave: Caus. -चारयति, to let or cause to traverse: Intens. p. -चर्चूर्यमाण, continuing following, RV. x, 124, 9.
a: अनुचर् — {c1c} P. 1 To follow, pursue, go after; to serve, attend or wait upon; पित्रोः पादाननुचरन् K. 368 serving. --2 To traverse, seek after, go through, wander. --3 To conduct oneself, behave.

m: अनु-चरा (ई, rarely आ), f. a female attendant.
अनु-चरी (ई, rarely आ), f. a female attendant.

s: tri, (anu sAhityena carati gacCati, anu + cara + wa .) sahacaraH । sahAyaH । ityamaraH ॥ dAsaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥ (“anucareRa DanADipateraTo” । iti BAraviH । “pEtfkaM vAYCato rAjyaM pArTasyAnucarA vyaDuH” । iti rAmAyaRaM .)
v: tri॰ anucarati anu + cara--wa striyAM NIp ac vA striyAM wAp । sahacare, paScAdgAmini, dAsAdO, “vratAya tenAnucareRa Denoriti” “anyedyurAtmAnucarasya BAvamiti ca” raGuH । anugataScaraM dUtaM gatisa॰ । dUtAnuge tri॰ । sevake ca, “ganDarvA guhyakAyakzA vibuDAnucarASca ye” iti manuH “catvAri ca SatAnyanucaraRAmiti” kO॰ brA॰ “apsaraso mahendrAnucarA daSeti “sOmitrisItAnucarasyeti” BawwiH । “pAlAgalI sAnucaryyaH Satena Satena” iti kAtyA॰ 20, 1, 12, etadvyAKyAyAM bahuSaH anucarISabdaprayogastatra drazwavyaH pAlAgalI dAsaputrI ।
m: अनु-चर mf(ई)n. following, attending
अनु-चर m. companion, follower, servant
a: अनुचरः — 1 A companion, follower, attendant, servant; तेनानुचरेण धेनोः R. 2. 4; आत्मानुचरस्य भावं जिज्ञासमाना 26, 52; Me. 3; Ms. 12. 47. In comp. attended or followed by; वानर˚, राक्षस˚ &c. --2 Following a spy ( चरमनुगतः). --री, --रा 1 A female attendant. --2 A logical or due strophe.

k.v: चर्मी फलकपाणिः स्यात्पताकी वैजयन्तिकः। अनुप्लवः सहायश्चानुचरोऽभिचरः समाः॥

m: अनु-चरण n. going after, wandering, Kauś.
अनु-चरण—चरित n. acts, deeds, adventures, BhP.
अनु-चर्चि mfn. reciting or repeating (in a chorus), ĀśvŚr.
a: अनुचर्चिः — f. Ved. Repeating (in a chorus).
अनुचरित — p. p. Followed &c. --तं Walk; walk in life; conduct.

m: अन्-उच्चार, अस्, m. or अन्-उच्चारण, अम्, n. non-pronunciation, skipping words (in reciting hymns). See उच्-√ चर्.
अन्-उच्चैस् ind. not aloud, in a low voice.

v: tri॰ na uccaH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । ucca tAviroDinimnatvavati । jyotizokte grahARAM nIcasTAne ca । tAni sTAnAni uccaSabde vakzyante ।
m: अन्-उच्च mfn. not high, low, humble
(= अन्-उदात्त), accentless, APrāt.
अन्-उच्चलत् mfn. not moving or going from (abl.), Śak.
अनु-√ 2. चि (Imper. Ā. -चिकिताम्) to remember, AV. vi, 53, 1.

a: अनुचिंत् — {c10c} P. To consider, think of, call to mind; धातुर्विभुत्वमनुचिंत्य वपुश्च तस्याः Ś. 2. 9; Bg. 8. 8; Ms. 4. 92.
अनुचिंता, --चिंतनं — 1 Calling to mind, thinking of, meditating upon. --2 Recalling, recollecting. --3 Constant thinking, anxiety.

m: अनु-√ चिन्त् to meditate, consider, recall to mind; Caus. to make to consider.

v: na॰ anu + cinti--lyuw । anusmaraRe satatacintAyAm “dvAdaSe mftyuBAve ca vEparItyAnucintanamiti jyoti॰ ।
m: अनु-चिन्तन,अम्, n. or अनु-चिन्ता, f. thinking of, meditating upon, recalling, recollecting anxiety.
अनु-चिन्तित mfn. recollected, recalled, thought of.
अनुचितार्थ m. an unusual meaning.
1. अनु-चित mfn. (√ 1. चि), set or placed along or lengthwise or in rows, AitBr.
2. अन्-उचित mfn. improper, wrong, unusual, strange.
a: अनुचित — a. 1 Wrong, improper. --2 Unusual; unfit.
